interfaces.name: Private/Data and internal-field declarations
interfaces.contract: Private is non-Value Data over an actual embedding-private VM symbol. Scope roots validate the real symbol kind; typed factory cloning preserves Private through persistent/scope reads. Name returns the actual symbol description. Native internal-field declarations accept Data, matching the original async-context private sentinel consumer.
interfaces.limits: General internal-field storage/layout still unimplemented; no claim that changing the declaration activates AsyncWrap fields. Private.New/ForApi and generic weak Data remain unavailable.

interfaces.name: Object.GetPrivate/SetPrivate and fixed Environment keys
interfaces.contract: Use the actual runtime symbol inventory and VM own-only hidden property storage. Private keys remain distinct from public Symbol values and from language #private fields. Native get/set use normal engine failure/exception propagation and cross-compartment wrapping; original reflection/proxy/freeze semantics come from the VM private-key implementation. Arrow/decorated/exit/untransferable/sentinel accessors share actual runtime keys.

interfaces.name: Value.IsNativeError/String.NewFromUtf8Literal
interfaces.contract: Native-error classification uses the actual unwrapped VM ErrorObject kind, including subclasses, without public prototype/instanceof traps. Literal length is known from the C++ array bound, excludes only the final terminator and preserves embedded NUL/UTF8 through the engine string allocator.

interfaces.name: Realm fatal/prepare callbacks and Environment getters
interfaces.contract: Native setters/getters share the existing per-context error-stack reserved slots with current JavaScript binding registration. Realm setters target their owning context; Environment getters read the principal context even from another active realm. Unregistered callbacks remain empty, never default success functions.

interfaces.name: Environment source-map callbacks, feature state and printed-error latch
interfaces.contract: Source/cache callbacks have actual independent strong native roots, setters can replace/clear them, and reads/calls preserve their identity/reentry/exceptions. Source-map enable and printed-error fields are independent foreground-owned state, initially false as in the original Environment. Callback roots are reset and the feature disabled at native shutdown.

validationObligations: Private root survives closed handle scope/full GC; own-only hidden reads/writes, freeze, proxies including revoked proxy, foreign realm and Buffer regressions.
Actual native Error/subclass/foreign versus forged/proxy objects; literal embedded NUL/Unicode.
Same callback identity across native and existing JS setters; principal/active context distinction.
Strong callbacks through GC, independent slots, reentrant clearing and original thrown value; promise job draining and registered root retirement at exit.
All prior45 private controls plus8 new drivers on four hosts with exact same identified program/kernel.
Exact normal link delta, unchanged original sources and byte-identical actual recipe inputs.
implementationGaps: Private.New/ForApi, generic weak Data and complete internal-field storage/layout are not implemented.
General Object.GetConstructorName remains undefined; do not infer creation metadata from mutable public prototypes.
Full original fatal/source-map binding initializer and complete fatal/report/process routing remain unactivated or unlinked.
Full OOM/security-wrapper/cancellation/lifetime/realm-retirement conformance is not established by selected controls.
Buffer ownership bridge still requires whole node_internals.h; environment-aware SafeGetenv and Message compiler-origin/end-range/text/options gaps remain.
